description: This file defines public interface functions for frontend API interactions, including retrieving the base URL for the backend API and fetching product data from the /products endpoint.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl()
methods.description: Returns the base URL for the backend API, prioritizing environment variable REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL, defaulting to 'http://localhost:3001'.

methods.name: fetchProducts()
methods.description: Fetches products from the backend /products endpoint, returning JSON data or throwing an error on failure.
